batting.name: PA Patel
batting.dismissal: c MK Pandey b B Kumar

batting.name: CL White
batting.dismissal: c AC Thomas b MN Samuels

batting.name: JD Ryder
batting.dismissal: c DJ Harris b Ankit Sharma

batting.name: SC Ganguly
batting.dismissal: c DJ Harris b MS Gony

batting.name: MN Samuels
batting.dismissal: c KC Sangakkara b A Ashish Reddy

batting.name: SPD Smith
batting.dismissal: c JP Duminy b J Theron

balls.text: Jaggi mis-times the last ball towards cover, and Deccan will only get a single
Duminy hits the ball straight past the bowler but he will only get one, Smith was too quick, running to his right from long-off
Ganguly chases valiantly and dives, has he pulled the ball in before he touched the boundary? He did. Jaggi had scooped the ball over short fine leg
steered towards third man
Duminy moves towards the off side to paddle the ball flat towards short fine leg, where the fielder jumps, gets a hand to the ball, but can't catch it. That was Manhas.
a low full toss, which Jaggi hits to long-on
a full toss outside off stump, Jaggi throws his bat at it and edges towards third man, he will keep strike for the start of the final over
nearly in the blockhole, but Duminy manages to work it towards midwicket, where Ryder prevents the second
once again he moves his front foot towards the leg side, but hits on the off side this time, towards mid off
Pandey sprints to his right from long-on and dives to cut off the boundary, Jaggi had opened his stance to hit the length ball through wide mid-on
Duminy mis-times the ball along the ground to long off
Nehra beats Duminy with a short of a length delivery outside off, Duminy tried to cut but was a bit too early on the shot
pushed towards extra cover for a single to retain strike
bowled flat and straight, Jaggi nudges to midwicket and runs a risky single to Ryder, whose throw missed at the bowler's end
that's bowled down leg side to Jaggi
played off the front foot towards cover point

caught on the deep cover boundary! White came forward and tried to loft the ball over extra cover again. It was the quicker ball and he sliced it high to Thomas on the boundary. Crucial moment in the game.
played in front of square for a single
Duminy's lined him up and slammed the ball back over the bowler's head, sending the ball towards the sight screen. Perfectly balanced while hitting that.
full ball outside off stump, White gets beaten this time as he tries to play square
that's length, and you can't bowl length to White in his mood. He simply lines it up and lofts flat over the long-on boundary
a full toss, which Duminy drives to long-off
White drives a full ball towards point, Duminy sprints through and beats the direct hit
Duminy hits the ball towards cover point
driven firmly along the ground to cover
he makes room again but bottom edges the ball past the keeper, he was looking to hit on the off side
this time it's straight! White makes room again and swings mightily, hitting the ball several rows back over the sight screen
tremendous hit! White makes room and hammers the flat ball inside out over extra cover, that's in the stands
White charges Sharma and drives the ball hard along the ground and past the bowler, once again long-off and long-on have no chance
played off the pads behind square
White backs away and hits the ball towards deep cover
whoops! Duminy gets beaten while trying to pull a slower short ball, and Uthappa gets beaten behind the stumps as well. The ball died on him and went between his legs. Uthappa didn't bend down.
driven down the ground for one more

that is some shot to bring up a maiden IPL fifty. The length was just short of a yorker length, White stayed in his crease and simply drilled the ball past the bowler, bisecting the gap between long-on and off
too full on the pads, Dunimy flicks and hits the ball hard, to Samuels at fine leg
the slower ball, bowled on a good length angling across the left-hander from over the wicket, Duminy plays towards point
full and straight, White can only dig it out towards mid-off
played off the pads behind square
now he plays the ball gently through the gap at midwicket, making time to run two
White makes room by moving towards leg, he isn't to the pitch of the ball but he simply lofts through the line, hitting the ball cleanly over the extra cover boundary
bowled flat and straight, Duminy plays in front of square leg
nudged off the pads through square leg
worls the ball with the angle into him from round the wicket through midwicket
driven on the front foot in front of point for a single
White drives a full ball towards long off
Duminy moves towards the line of the ball around off and steers towards third man
full ball on leg and middle stump, clipped off the pads in front of square
played off the pads behind square
Duminy moves forward and across to play towards midwicket
short ball outside off, White cuts and with tremendous power, the fielder on the point boundary has no chance
Duminy stays back and works the ball off his pads behind square
White was aiming for leg side but ended up hitting it past the bowler's left
White has made room and clobbered that ball flat through extra cover, that might have been in the air but no one was going to catch that in the circle
nudged towards point to get off the mark

bowled him! Sangakkara's middle stump has been uprooted. He charged the legspinner and swung across the line, he wasn't to the pitch of the ball and it went off the inside edge on to middle stump. Sharma gave Sangakkara quite a send off. A flying kiss of sorts, I think.
that's a fortunate boundary. White was aiming for deep midwicket with that hoick but he got a thick inside edge that sent that ball past short fine leg
Sangakkara stays on the back foot and chips the ball straight over the bowler's head, deliberately hit with not much power
White moves his front foot towards leg to heave the ball through midwicket but mis-times it towards Ganguly in the circle
played towards cover
shot! Sangakkara makes room and launches a length ball flat over extra cover. Deccan have scored only 24 in the last five overs, they need these boundaries
length ball outside off stump, White makes room and hits the ball flat towards long-off, reaches the fielder on the first bounce
defended on the off side
Sanga stays in his crease and taps the ball gently into the huge gap at midwicket, he's hit it softly enough to take on Smith running in from the deep and complete two
White moves across and glances the ball behind square
the reverse paddle! But White can't beat short third man
bowled quick and straight, White leans forward and clips off his toes through square leg
a bit too short, Sanga stays in his crease and plays in front of square leg
the first ball from round the wicket is bowled down leg side
that's the quicker ball outside off stump, White tries to swat but gets beaten
White moves forward and plays to Sharma again
White tries to blast down the ground but mis-times the ball just wide of the bowler
flatter and shorter ball follows the fuller one that got smashed, White plays off the back foot on the off side
he's slogged this, and slogged it well. Clearing his front foot and hoisting the ball over the midwicket boundary
White steps out to Sharma, isn't to the pitch of the ball, and is forced to defend
White stays in his crease and nudges off his pads towards midwicket
Sangakkara steps out of his crease and is greeted by a short of a length ball that climbs, the batsman adjusts to the bounce and opens the face to steer behind point
White tries to drive but gets an outside edge behind point
Sanga moves forward and opens the face to steer a length ball from outside off towards third man
driven on the front foot towards cover
good length on off stump, driven from the crease to mid-off
played back to the bowler off the back foot
White stays back to the leg break and punches towards long on
this time he moves across to glance the ball off his pads behind square
Sangakkara moves back and across and plays towards square leg
played off the backfoot
flat short ball outside off, White hits it hard from the crease through cover point
caught at deep square leg! Parthiv was trying to play that flick over the boundary but mis-timed the pick-up shot, lofting it to Mithun Manhas who had to move in very little to take the catch
White makes room by moving towards leg but Kumar follows him, White clips off his pads behind square. Deccan have got to 50
good length around off stump, White defends once again
defended on the front foot towards the off side
the length isn't right for the hoick over square leg but Parthiv goes for it anyway, the ball hits the pad and lobs on the off side
Parthiv square drives from his crease but can't beat Smith at backward point
driven from the crease towards mid-on
short ball, and White pounces, pulling with power to the midwicket boundary, he hit that along the ground and very hard
White defends another accurate ball, delivered on a good length on off stump
good length around off stump, defended on the front foot
a slower ball bowled short of a length, Parthiv tries to swat but misses and is hit on the pad, there was some bat on it though and they run a single to square leg
too straight, Parthiv glances off his pads to the fine leg boundary, poor line from Thomas

Robin Uthappa has demolished the stumps and Dhawan is well short! Parthiv dropped the ball close on the off side and the batsmen ran. A bizarre decision. The ball went straight towards Pandey, who sprinted in from cover and returned the ball accurately to the wicketkeeper. Dhawan didn't have a chance.
too full on the pads, Parthiv simply flicks his wrists, lofting the ball over square leg and just far enough to clear the boundary
good length on off stump, played with an open face towards backward point
good length but the line is a bit straight from Kumar, Parthiv nudges off his pads towards short fine leg
nudged off the pads behind square
good length and straight, driven to mid-on

that's high and far over wide long-on. Dhawan charged Samuels again, didn't get to the pitch of the ball, but swung hard anyway. He made clean contact and the timing was terrific. He had to reach for the ball and drag it from outside off stump
tries to sweep but doesn't make proper contact
driven to deep cover

dropped? Only technically. Dhawan charged Samuels, reached out for the ball and swatted it hard and flat towards the bowler's right, Samuels stuck out his hand and made contact with the ball, the deflection nearly hit the umpire
bowled full and straight, driven on the front foot towards mid-off
nudged off the pads towards midwicket
loud shout for lbw after Parthiv misses the flick, but that probably pitched outside leg, only three runs off the over
a yorker, Parthiv tried to steer it towards third man but the ball crashed into the edge of the bat
good length and straight, dropped close on the off side and the batsmen sprint through
Dhawan is pinned to his crease and plays towards cover
a slower ball, good length around off stump, the batsman was into the drive too early and had to wait before pushing to cover
length ball on the pads, glanced off the back foot towards short fine leg
tucked off the pads towards square leg, big first over for Deccan
a terrific shot to get off the mark, Dhawan punches off the back foot through cover and the ball screams across this outfield

Parthiv moves across his stumps to play on the leg side and misses, the ball his the pad and goes on the off side. They attempt a leg bye. Steve Smith races in from point, picks up and throws at the bowler's end. He hits the stumps but the batsman is safe and the ball ricochets off the stumps towards the boundary. Ganguly has to chase again
short of a length and wide outside off, Parthiv cracks it off the back foot, cutting behind point and beating the fielder at third man
Parthiv clips the ball off his pads wide of mid-on, this outfield is quick, far too quick for the man in pursuit of the ball - Sourav Ganguly.
good length around off stump, Parthiv pushes forward and plays towards cover. Hesitation between the wickets and they don't run in the end
backs away and slices the ball towards third man, look at that smile on Sangakkara's face. He's beaming!
length ball around off stump, lofted inside out over cover, it falls safely in the deep
now he charges and swings, gets beaten by a pacy short of a length ball
another short ball, Kumar stays in his crease and chips it over the keeper to the third man boundary

Thomas charges and then tries to cut, he gets beaten by the short ball once again. Thomas continues running but Manhas doesn't want to steal the bye. Parthiv scored a direct hit with his under-arm throw and Thomas is run out
Thomas backs away to cut a short of a length ball. Gony followed the batsman and cramped him for room, and beat the bat
well that isn't a terrific finish for Theron, he's missed his yorker length, allowing Manhas to get under the ball and smash it straight over the sight screen. Tremendous hit, but probably too late
terrific finish to the over, another yorker, dug out behind square
clears his front foot and slogs through midwicket, to the fielder in the deep
that's too wide outside off stump
in the blockhole on middle stump, Thomas manages to keep it out, running after the ball rolls towards the keeper
a slower ball outside off stump, the batsman had finished swinging across the line by the time the ball reached him
in the blockhole around off stump, driven to cover
hit with power down the ground for a single
played on the leg side

is that caught? Is that six? Duminy's signalled that it's a six. Manhas backed away, made room and slogged the ball high over the bowler's head. Duminy ran to his left from long-on, judged the catch well and jumped to take it. As he landed, though, his foot touched the line. He then threw the ball to Harris, who had run from long-off. Harris caught it, but Duminy knew it was six and said so
tries to cut but gets a bottom edge into the ground towards short third man
in the blockhole outside off stump, squeezed out to the man behind point
clipped off the pads behind square
Theron's over has ended horribly. Manhas has powered the last ball over Duminy at long-on. It was a length ball and Manhas got under it nicely. Pune are not out of this yet.

that's probably the game! Smith got under a low full toss but couldn't loft it high and far enough. He hit it towards long-on, where Duminy moved forward and to his right and slid to take a low catch. The ball was dying on him
that's wide outside off, Smith threw his bat at it but couldn't reach it
hit towards long off for a single, not quite in the blockhole
a length ball, and Smith hits hard towards midwicket, where the fielder dives to save runs
in the blockhole once again, the batsman can't do much but drive to long-on
in the blockhole outside off stump, Smith squeezes it out on the off side
that's a high full toss and Smith has swung hard and pulled it over the long-leg boundary. Rubbish delivery. That was a no-ball for height.
in the blockhole outside off stump, Manhas tries to squeeze on the off side but is beaten
good length but wide outside off, Smith reaches for it and cuts in front of point, it was another slower ball
Smith winds up, and unwinds with a tremendous heave, smashing a slower ball high and just over Gony on the long-on boundary
Manhas gets another outside edge towards third man, while trying to hit over cover
Smith was aiming for extra cover, the thick inside edge rolled towards long-on instead
hit from the crease towards cover
Manhas aims for deep cover, he finds third man, the ball going off the outside edge of the big drive
short of a length ball and Smith swings across the line again, pulling along the ground to deep square leg
Smith has latched on to a length ball and swung it high over square leg, it wasn't a pull, more of a whippy hoick
Manhas backs away and manages to cut the ball from off and middle stump towards third man, so dangerous
Manhas tries to pull, but mis-times it to midwicket
Smith flicks the ball off his pads to short fine leg

Samuels has played an abysmal shot to get caught at cover. He simply cleared his front foot and swung hard, not sure where he wanted the ball to go. He ended up lobbing it to Sangakkara. Deccan firmly on top now.
the slower ball outside off, Smith drives to cover
cut off the back foot towards short third man
Samuels was gone had the fielder at mid-on hit at the bowler's end! He hit the ball hard to Sangakkara and just ran, Sangakkara missed though
length ball outside off, Smith stays back and opens the face to play to third man
bowled him! Uthappa moved extremely wide outside the off stump to paddle a fullish ball past short fine leg. He paddled it alright, just on to leg stump.
full ball wide outside off, Uthappa drives off the front foot through cover. Three runs off that Theron over. Gold for Deccan.
good length, swinging into the right-hander, Samuels hits the ball gently towards long-on
stays in his crease once again and dabs to cover, Sangakkara picks up and throws at Uthappa's end, hitting the stumps direct. Uthappa is safe.
exceptional line and length around off stump, Samuels simply stays in his crease and plays to point. Samuels does like his crease.
Uthappa tries to open the face and dab towards third man but bottom edges into the ground towards backward point
good length angling into off stump, the batsman stays in his crease and plays towards backward point
played towards point for a single
Uthappa throws his bat at a wide ball but misses, the ball hits the keeper's pads and goes to short third man
cut off the back foot but to the man at backward point, the length was too short again and Uthappa missed out
Uthappa beats short third man with the latest of dabs, he waited until the ball was nearly past him before opening the face to guide the short ball
Samuels stays in his crease and dabs the ball late, placing it towards third man
short ball outside off, dabbed from the crease to short third man
a full toss outside off, Uthappa drives to the fielder on the edge of the circle at cover
the reverse swat, but the shot doesn't beat short third man
that's the googly and it hits Samuels on the pad as he tries to defend, Mishra appeals for lbw but that was missing leg
hit with power towards long-off
played towards point where Sanga misfields and allows two runs, let it go straight through him
Mishra tosses the ball up and wide outside off stump, Uthappa reaches for it and slogs but gets beaten by the turn
Samuels defends his first ball down near his pink shoes

caught at short cover! Super catch. Duminy's drop has cost Chargers hardly anything. Ganguly stepped out to a short and wide ball and swatted it hard, the ball travelled quickly at head height to Daniel Harris, who was well balanced as he caught it. Harris is on the field for White.
Uthappa moves across and flicks the ball off his pads, the fielder at short fine leg dives to his left and makes the save
Ganguly's trying to keep up with the times! He moves towards the off side and tries to paddle scoop the ball from wide outside off, it lobs towards square leg and falls safely
played back towards the bowler
nearly get Ganguly out, that's what! Duminy's dropped a sitter at point! Ganguly cut a short of a length ball straight to Duminy, it went in and popped out
fuller and straighter, Ganguly drives towards long-on
he persists with his bizarre line outside leg stump, this time it is a wide
Uthappa goes back and has to hurry to pull the googly through midwicket
on Uthappa's pads this time, he glances fine, beating short fine leg and sending the ball racing to the boundary
again the line is outside leg, Ganguly tries to hit over square leg but misses and is hit on the pad
outside leg-stump line, Ganguly gets down low and sweeps, hitting the ball firmly to the deep square leg boundary. Terrible line from Mishra
Uthappa goes back and punches the ball to long on
defended on the off side
Duminy thinks the ball has hit the pad first after Ganguly came forward to defend. So he appealed for lbw. Ganguly played the ball on the off side and started running, Uthappa sent him back
slants down leg side and Ganguly glances it fine, past the keeper and to the boundary
Ganguly gets hit on the pad as he tries to play towards leg, an appeal for lbw but that was missing leg
punched off the back foot, Duminy dives to his left but can't field the ball
Uthappa gets beaten by a quicker ball that slides across him from round the wicket
Uthappa goes back again, makes room and cuts in front of point
nudged off the pads towards midwicket
bowled full and straight, defended back to the bowler
played off the back foot towards point
Uthappa steps out of his crease and punches the ball flat towards wide long-off, hitting it far enough to just clear Gony on the boundary
defended back to the bowler
another one nearly in the blockhole, Ganguly stays in his crease and plays on the off side
Uthappa moves forward and steers the ball to third man
Uthappa plays the ball from the blockhole towards the bowler
bowled him! The length was good and the ball skidded on to Pandey just outside off stump, he tried to steer to third man once again but bottom edged the ball on to his stumps
superbly steered, the length was blockhole, the line around off stump, Pandey stayed balanced, bent down low, and opened the face of the bat to steer the ball to the third man boundary
Ganguly goes big, clears front leg, and cracks a full delivery over long on
tries to whip off the pads, but cannot connect, dribbles off the pad square on leg
short and down the leg side as he misses a pull
played out to point
misses the flick to one on the pads, ball rolls to the keeper
worked away to midwicket
dabs an angled delivery down to third man
makes some room and guides it wide of extra cover who dives and fields, White it is
again he tries to tee off, mishits it this time, too much in fact, as deep midwicket cannot get to it as he runs in
that has been speared way down the leg side
pushes a quicker one to the bowler
thwack! he 's swiped this full delivery high, and just over long on in the end
pushed to extra cover, Pandey sends Ganguly back
on middle and leg, turned to short midwicket
poor line, down the pads, and he tickles it past the keeper
defended down the pitch off the front foot
gone, just like that, he's pushed a length ball with the spin straight to short midwicket
that kept a shade low from back of a length, he adjusted well to sweep it to short fine
down the track and lifts it with a straight bat over mid off
gets forward to a tossed up ball and pushes to extra cover
clears front leg, and bashes it over mid off
clipped through vacant midwicket
flat and quick, hit down to long on
around middle and leg from a  length, worked square on leg
hit down to mid off
pushed towards midwicket for a single
pushed on the off side
tries to hit in the air but misses and is hit on the pads, that was going down leg
hit wide of midwicket for a single
pushes this one in the air towards midwicket
defends a tossed up ball onto the off side
